title: MGPDecisionRecord
description: JSON Schema for phase6.defense.policy.records.MGPDecisionRecord -- mirrors phase3/schemas/memory_schema.json's own convention (a real, checkable schema alongside the Python dataclass, not a substitute for it). Every field name and type here corresponds exactly to the real dataclass fields; this schema is validated against real, constructed instances by phase6/tests/test_schemas.py, not hand-verified once and left to drift.

decision_id.description: Deterministic SHA-256-derived identity, minted by mint_decision_id() -- never a random UUID.

policy_version.description: e.g. 'mgp-1.0.0' -- read from records.CURRENT_POLICY_VERSION, the single source-of-truth constant.

signals_used.description: Raw signal name/value pairs. Must never contain a key from phase6.defense.policy.records.FORBIDDEN_SIGNAL_KEYS -- enforced at construction time in code; this schema only checks shape, not the denylist itself (a JSON Schema cannot express 'not one of this dynamic Python set' cleanly, so the real enforcement stays in Python).

reason.description: Must be evidence-grounded, built from signals_used -- never fabricated independently (Policy document Section 4).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601, human-audit only -- never used for ordering logic.

evidence_refs.description: At least one real Phase 3/5 event id -- a decision with no evidence reference is a bare claim, forbidden by Policy document Section 4.
